comparison.objective: Choose fitting tweezers and peel protective film from a display carrier, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Select a tool by slot fit, stabilize a loose carrier, grip a film tab, and perform controlled adhesive peeling.
comparison.success_condition: All adhesive detached without excessive carrier motion or premature seam separation; film and tools stowed and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tool selection and adhesive peeling are materially different from socket/collar adjustment and dynamic validation.
